scope: bounded paired finite-sketch and exact-CX microbenchmarks; baseline/setup may run before new solver correctness gate

full_fit_smoke.purpose: bounded convergence and quality smoke only; no recovery or selection claim

supplemental_local_calibration.status: frozen after primary suite; separate and non-retroactive
supplemental_local_calibration.construction: isotropic Gaussian U; orthonormal Ytruth; I=U Ytruth g without noise; Yinit is the polar factor of Ytruth plus 0.05 times a horizontal Gaussian perturbation
supplemental_local_calibration.purpose: local near-solution calibration for same-certificate behavior; no change to primary suite selection

supplemental_weak_signal_calibration.status: frozen before run; one final supplemental case, no tuning
supplemental_weak_signal_calibration.construction: isotropic Gaussian U; orthonormal Ytruth; planted coefficient column 1 scaled by 0.03; I=U Ytruth g without noise; Yinit is the polar factor of Ytruth plus 0.05 times a horizontal Gaussian perturbation
supplemental_weak_signal_calibration.purpose: final weak-signal recovery calibration; no selection or further budget expansion

schur_core_kernel.warmup: separate K not included in timing; each timed trial uses a distinct K
schur_core_kernel.purpose: kernel-only inactive coefficient elimination evidence; not a solver promotion or selection benchmark

measurement.warmup: operator actions and Schur kernel use an untimed warmup; whole solver arms start timing at the first solve after imports, with imports excluded
measurement.order: frozen arm order, serial subprocesses; no simultaneous timed experiments
measurement.tau_mapping: solver local_ridge is set to tau; only tau=0 was run
measurement.positive_tau_stress: not run; optional stress excluded from this bounded study
